name: What is communism (ru -> it)
_about: Glossary for the whole booklet, built by build_glossary.py: names in the scientific transliteration used by Italian Wikipedia, established Italian titles, short canonical formulas of Marx, Engels and Lenin, the author's coinages, and the Marxist lexicon. Each source lists the inflected forms found in the Russian text, separated by '|', so TranslateBooksWithLLMs' per-chunk filter matches them. Use with: python translate.py ... --glossary italiano/glossary.ru-it.json
